raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Add RedHatAI checkpoint variants and external speculative decoders to the existing Qwen3 recipe pages.

## Claims

- Covers Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, 8B, 14B, and 30B-A3B.
- Keeps the existing default checkpoint selections unchanged.
- Labels Blackwell-specific NVFP4 variants for Blackwell hardware.

## Validation

Validation is pending; this PR is intentionally a draft.

- Passed: `git diff --check`.
- Planned source validation (not run): from `/home/Roderick-Wu/recipes`, run `pnpm install` if dependencies are missing, then:
  `node scripts/validate-source.mjs --source vllm --dir /home/Roderick-Wu/recipe-worktrees/qwen3/recipes`
- Planned serving smoke test (not run): use the command generated for each H100-compatible checkpoint on the 8xH100 node, then run:
  ```bash
  curl -fsS http://localhost:8000/v1/models
  curl -fsS http://localhost:8000/v1/chat/completions -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"<served-model-id>","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Reply with READY."}],"max_tokens":16}'
  ```
- The NVFP4 variants marked Blackwell-only need Blackwell hardware.

## Details

Checkpoint IDs, speculative token counts, version constraints, and references are recorded in the YAML. AI assistance was used to prepare this change.

---

<details>
<summary>Pull Request Checklist</summary>

- [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill.
- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.
- [x] Design Fit: confines changes to existing recipe files and preserves defaults.
- [ ] Testing and Validation: pending author validation listed above.
- [x] Code Quality and Style: `git diff --check` passed.
- [x] Pull Request Contents: includes checkpoint scope, limitations, and a validation plan.
</details>
